basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a recent tech enthusiast diving into the world of Arch Linux and different desktop environments. Originally from Calgary, Canada, I spend most of my evenings experimenting with tech setups or tending to my aquarium. I work as a junior software developer, which keeps me busy during the day, but I always find time to explore my hobbies in the evenings and weekends. Not in a relationship currently, I enjoy the company of my pets and the occasional social outing with friends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I'm a self-taught tech enthusiast who started exploring Linux about a year ago. My knowledge is mostly from online tutorials, forums, and trial and error. I have a basic understanding but I'm eager to learn more, especially about the nuances of different display servers like Wayland and Xorg.
